chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about the words of God, Mighty and Majestic:
'O you who believe! Fear God and be with the truthful ones' [9:119].
He said: 'The truthful ones are the Imams, and the very truthful (are those who adhere) through obedience to them.'

key_terms.الصَّادِقِينَ: The truthful ones — the Imams of Ahl al-Bayt in Shia interpretation of 9:119
key_terms.الصِّدِّيقُونَ: The very truthful/sincere — believers who attain this rank through obedience to the Imams
key_terms.بِطَاعَتِهِمْ: Through obedience to them — emphasizing that following the Imams is the path to sincerity

ai.seo_question: Who are 'the truthful ones' mentioned in Quran 9:119 according to Imam al-Ridha?
ai.summary: In this hadith, Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha (AS), the eighth Imam, interprets the Quranic command in 9:119 — 'be with the truthful ones' — as referring specifically to the Imams of Ahl al-Bayt. The term 'al-Sadiqun' (the truthful ones) is identified with the Imams, while 'al-Siddiqun' (the very truthful/sincere) refers to those believers who achieve this station through their obedience to the Imams. This interpretation was given to Ibn Abi Nasr al-Bazanti, a trusted companion who recorded many teachings of this Imam.
